lore_anchors.definition: The most dangerous part of the Heavenly Tribulation in Xianxia. It manifests as illusions born from a cultivator's deepest fears, regrets, and desires, attacking their soul and Dao-heart directly.
The highest tier of Ki Refining cultivator within the Three Realms, a step above a True Immortal. Their power is absolute and they are among the most influential beings in the universe.

A sacred and dangerous location in the Heavenly Realm. It is a burial ground for ancient gods which, due to their residual power, has become a place of miraculous vitality, giving birth to sentient plant-life that cultivates into beautiful female immortals.
The nominal ruler of the Heavenly Court and head administrator of the Three Realms, though his personal combat power is often surpassed by reclusive cultivators and ancient True Gods.

The supreme defensive divine ability in the Three Realms. It grants its user nigh-indestructibility and does not consume divine power in its passive state, making its wielder incredibly difficult to kill.
Skills and methods that diverge from mainstream Daoist cultivation. They are often unique, difficult to counter, and can allow a weaker cultivator to match or escape from a much stronger opponent.
